_comment: Per-category PASSED counts (pass + flaky) of the previous accepted release gate. The gate fails a category whose passed count is below GATE_DROP_THRESHOLD (default 70 percent) of its value here, unless it was started with --allow-count-drop "<reason>". Refresh from "baseline_candidate" of a GREEN gate report after each release. Only tier L has a baseline; S and M print a warning (the count-drop check is not applied). A diff-selection gate never checks the ratio (it prints 'selection'), so these values only matter for a full tier-L run (nightly, --full).
source: GATEAUDIT-297 (2026-10-27): the last FULL tier-L run is the nightly on main @ 011c97d4d (2.23.1, 2026-10-27 02:00): baseline_candidate preview 15086, dev 1038, pixel 221, fixture 15, backend 17611. Adjusted for what changed after it: the bubble freeze (2.23.2) skips 151 preview and 101 dev tests that passed there (whole-file skips + every test titled with the bubble skin); pixel +25 (the visual-matrix baselines re-taken here now pass), -8 (the evidence-design-foundation zero-pixel duplicates removed here), about -20 (bubble pixel cases now skipped). The values are therefore an estimate within a few percent, far inside the 70 percent threshold; replace them with the baseline_candidate of the first green full tier-L run that contains this branch. The previous values (integ/293-rel @ b3788047, 2026-10-20: preview 11935, dev 936, pixel 188, backend 12106) were a week and about 3000 preview / 5500 backend tests behind.
